q1_issues.issue: The RatherThan atom relates two sealed (And ...) terms instead of the two reified eventualities the inter-clause-connective section prescribes, so the rejected alternative sk_live_2 and its class atom exist only inside the seal and are unreachable by an ordinary event query.

q2_gaps: 'rather than VP, VP' — a preferential / substitutive connective whose first clause is a REJECTED alternative that must not be asserted; the connective section covers only cause / purpose / concession / contrast and assumes both endpoints are asserted eventualities, so it offers no sanctioned shape for an unasserted endpoint

predicative capacity 'as a N' ('live one day as a tiger'): no rule decides whether the as-phrase's article-bearing NP mints a typed witness (the oblique object-NP rule) or stays a bare non-specific class symbol (the generic-object rule) — the parse chose the bare class 'tiger' / 'rabbit'
notes: RatherThan follows the section's multiword CamelCase-join convention (AsAResult), but 'rather than' states preference rather than cause / purpose / concession / contrast, so no rule licenses the head. The imperative half is handled correctly — Directive seal, no addressee referent, no tense — and the two duration measures are right.
